title: Configuring OpenID for Single Sign-On Using Okta

blocks.text: Zscaler recommends using Authentication Service to configure primary and secondary external identity providers (IdPs). Authentication Service supports both SAML and OpenID configurations. Contact Zscaler Support to subscribe to Authentication Service.
This article provides information on configuring OpenID for single sign-on (SSO) using Okta.
Before you configure OpenID for SSO, make sure to configure OpenID on Okta with the following settings:

blocks.item: Select Web Application as the application type.
See image.
Use https://<Zscaler Deception Instance Name>/oauth as the sign-in redirect URI.
See image.

blocks.text: To configure OpenID for SSO using Okta:

blocks.item: Step 1: Obtain the Client ID and Client Secret from Okta
Log in to the Okta portal as an administrator.
Go to Applications > Applications.
Select the application that you created while configuring OpenID for Okta.
Select General.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secrets.
See image.
Step 2: Obtain the OpenID Endpoint Configuration for Okta
Enter the following URL in the browser:
https://<Okta Instance>.okta.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
When the configuration file opens, copy the following information:
issuer
authorization_endpoint
token_endpoint
jwks_uri
See image.
Step 3: Configure OpenID for SSO on the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal
After you obtain the client ID, client secret, and endpoint configuration details, you must configure OpenID for SSO in the Deception Admin Portal.
